The '''Happy Bergruutfa Cantina''' was [[Planet/Legends|planet]]-based [[Cantina/Legends|cantina]]. A group of [[Alliance to Restore the Republic/Legends|Rebels]] talked with a [[Spaceport/Legends|spaceport]] [[Technician/Legends|technician]] about the cantina.
